name: CRM
desc: Build a CRM platform — contacts, pipeline, and sales automation with an AI assistant layer.
features:
## Core
- Contact & account records — full interaction history, custom fields, bulk import
- Lead capture & qualification — web-to-lead forms, assignment & routing rules
- Deal pipeline with custom stages — drag-and-drop board, multiple pipelines
- Activity & task tracking — calls, meetings, reminders, unified timeline
- Email sync, tracking & templates — two-way inbox sync, open/click tracking
- Sales forecasting — quota vs. pipeline, forecast categories, close-date projection
- Custom reports & dashboards
- Workflow automation — trigger→action rules, approvals
- Role-based security & granular permissions
- REST API + integration marketplace
- Native mobile app

## Differentiators
- AI sales assistant — predictive lead/deal scoring, AI email drafting, record & call summaries
- Automated sequences / cadences — multi-touch email/call/task outreach with branching
- Conversation intelligence — call recording, transcription, keyword & coaching insights
- CPQ — product catalog, quote configuration, price rules, e-signature
